css: .t{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--primary);color:var(--text);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:0 9vmin;}.t-word{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:17vmin;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.01em;}.t-word .jv-char{display:inline-block;animation:t-rise 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * 45ms);}@keyframes t-rise{from{transform:translateY(60%);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}.t-rule{height:0.4vmin;width:0;background:var(--secondary);margin:4vmin 0 3vmin;animation:t-grow 600ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) 500ms both;}@keyframes t-grow{to{width:22vmin}}.t-tag{font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:3vmin;letter-spacing:0.06em;opacity:0;animation:t-fade 500ms ease-out 800ms both;}@keyframes t-fade{to{opacity:0.85}}
